name: Vercingetorix the Red
notes: AC 16. Dying -- has been for two years. Moves faster because of it. Neither ally nor enemy.
gm_notes: Objective: close the wound the spear opened three generations ago. Goal: survive long enough to see the ritual completed. Agenda: test the party before trusting them with tribal knowledge. Secret: knows Brutus contacted two warband chieftains before the siege -- only reveals this after the Session 4 ritual IF the ritual was genuine. If shadow-cursed Spartan is in party: he recognizes Ares-blood on first private look. Says 'You carry an old war in you. Not Roman. Older.'
